modules.name: Yeno’s Orbit
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v1.3: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora backgrounds. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen.

modules.name: Yeno’s Orbit Lite
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Lite version for low-end devices, still in space. A pre-rendered milky way and starfield with a soft twinkle sit behind the player (drawn from pictures, so almost free for the GPU). The same circular cover, visualizer ring, progress moon, glass controls, colour themes, text, lyrics and padding options, but without the live nebula, galaxy and black hole shaders, shooting stars, cover rim, wave seek bar, glowing play-button and equalizer-icon shaders, and without blur in the animations. Pick No stars in the background variants for the lightest look.

modules.name: Yeno's Orbit Tablet
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Tablet edition for Tablet 3:2 screens: the whole player is scaled up and the sky fills the screen. Your music in orbit. A circular cover ringed by a visualizer that glows brighter as the song plays, a progress arc with a glowing moon, a twinkling starfield, a live seek bar and controls on frosted glass. v2.0: make it yours - 6 colour themes, 4 visualizer rings, sky, seek bar, controls, title and lyrics styles, spinning cover, song change animations, background variants, plus the queue bar and audio format badge. New: galaxy, black hole, deep nebula and aurora backgrounds. Tap the artist name or the song title to open their page. Top and bottom padding sliders fit the player to any screen.

modules.name: Yeno's Orbit Tablet Lite
modules.author: Yeno
modules.description: Tablet edition for Tablet 3:2 screens. Lite version for low-end devices, still in space. A pre-rendered milky way and starfield with a soft twinkle sit behind the player (drawn from pictures, so almost free for the GPU). The same circular cover, visualizer ring, progress moon, glass controls, colour themes, text, lyrics and padding options, but without the live nebula, galaxy and black hole shaders, shooting stars, cover rim, wave seek bar, glowing play-button and equalizer-icon shaders, and without blur in the animations. Pick No stars in the background variants for the lightest look.

modules.name: Miku Player
modules.author: you
modules.description: Immersive card with edge progress, a spinning vinyl, 3 lyric styles (Classic, Kinetic, Karaoke), 5 seek bars, 7 song-change animations, 8 vinyl styles (Classic, Colored, Splatter, Smoke, Heart-shaped, Split color, Liquid-filled, Glitter), 4 cover plastics (Glossy shrink-wrap, PVC sleeve, Hype sticker, Worn sleeve), a second player 'Miku Vinyl' (big translucent vinyl over the cover with a tonearm, portrait and landscape) a third player 'Miku Home' (same layout as Miku on a wooden table with a turntable) and backgrounds (Aurora, Ambient Pulse, Matrix Spectrum, Adaptive solid colour) Lyrics icon button and an optional queue bar. A fourth player 'Mivinyls' (only the vinyl disc and the tonearm, portrait and landscape). Miku v2: glass card with the cover in the middle and a spinning vinyl behind it. Every player can show the audio quality.

modules.name: Terminal Vintage
modules.author: Adi
modules.description: A modern terminal-inspired music player look for Mochy, with a clean TUI layout, customizable themes, synced lyrics, audio visualizers and queue details.

modules.name: BitGlass
modules.author: cannavis
modules.description: Liquid glass bars + a full-bleed cover player

modules.name: Cozy Pink
modules.author: you
modules.description: Soft pastel player: 3D vinyl with tonearm + character, wavy seek bar, star spread on like, choose frosted / liquid / normal glass

modules.name: Sn-Haze
modules.author: Solora N
modules.description: A clean Spotify-style now playing screen on a heavily blurred album cover: sharp square cover with a soft shadow, title and artist with a like heart, a thin seek line with a round knob, and a big white play button.

modules.name: Vinyl Wave Player
modules.author: sahara
modules.description: Trình phát sáng/tối với ảnh bìa bo góc, đĩa than xoay, thanh bên mảnh và đường seek lượn sóng. Studio tùy biến (hàng mảnh ghép trong menu): xem trước trực tiếp, 6 bộ cài sẵn, kiểu nền Tự động/Flow/Aurora/Bokeh/Mesh, lớp phủ và màu phủ nền, màu tên bài, nghệ sĩ, lời bài hát, màu đĩa than, màu rãnh, viền bìa, cỡ trình phát và cỡ lời. Tự động theo bìa: màu và kiểu nền đổi theo từng bìa nhạc. Hiệu ứng theo bass, nốt nhạc bay, chế độ tĩnh, ẩn đĩa than, nút tim/shuffle/repeat có hiệu ứng. | Light and dark player with a rounded cover, spinning vinyl, a slim side rail and a wavy seek line. A Studio page (the puzzle-piece row in the menu) with a live preview, 6 presets, background styles Auto/Flow/Aurora/Bokeh/Mesh, background veil and tint, colours for title, artist, lyrics, vinyl, grooves and cover border, plus player and lyric size. Auto cover makes colours and background style follow each cover. Bass-reactive effects, floating notes, calm mode, hidden vinyl and animated heart, shuffle and repeat buttons.

modules.name: VitroPlayer

modules.name: Sn-Float
modules.author: LocalHostUser
modules.description: A simple, minimalistic player with edge lyrics in 5 styles (including a word-by-word Focus karaoke), a visualizer with 9 selectable styles (bars, mirror, dots, wave, area, LED, capsules, needles, aurora) on the right edge, a seek bar in 4 styles (line, wave, dots, equalizer), a sharp album cover with an adjustable shadow in 4 positions, an optional minimal queue bar and clean floating controls with liquid glass bars.

modules.author: ProfitableYeno
modules.description: MOCHY/STOCKS with a live price that moves with the music. Full-width candles, moving averages, Bollinger bands, volume and RSI, with the newest candle pulsing on every beat. Buy mochy stocks now!!11!!! Get rich Four indicator sets: Classic plus Trend, Levels and Flow packs (3 indicators each).
